tagline: The Soviet / Russian heavy-lift workhorse 1967-2012 — Salyut, Mir, Venera, Vega, Luna sample-return
description: Three-stage hypergolic (N2O4 / UDMH) heavy-lift vehicle with optional Blok-D / D-1 / D-2 high-energy upper stages. 311 launches between 1967-03-10 and 2012-03-30 — anchored every Salyut + Mir + ISS Russian-segment module, every Venera and Vega Venus probe, every Luna sample-return, and Soviet Mars-2/-3/-5/-7. The Blok-D upper stage was originally developed for the cancelled N1-L3 crewed lunar architecture; reusing it on Proton-K kept the heavy-energy Soviet planetary line viable into the 1980s. Replaced by Proton-M which still flies.
